title: GDPR
intro: GDPR requires us to inform our members that we collect data, what data we collect, and why we collect it.

scoutnet.title: Scoutnet
scoutnet.description: Scoutnet is the Scouts' shared membership registry, and we collect the following information about each member:
list: If parents have a role in the troop*
If siblings are members of the troop*
scoutnet.childrenInfo: These details are also collected for children on the registration waiting list. Information about siblings and parents is used for sibling priority and placement.
scoutnet.purpose: The purpose of collecting data in Scoutnet is to know who our members are, communicate with them, register attendance, manage section and patrol affiliation, and handle invoicing. We never enter health information into Scoutnet.
scoutnet.access: Leaders and the board can generate reports, but no one outside HSS has access to the registry. Information is shared with the municipality for attendance reporting. When a member leaves, their data is removed from HSS's view.
scoutnet.insurance: The insurance company requires that data be stored for up to ten years.

hikes.title: Data collection for hikes and camps
hikes.registration: Registration is done via email or web form. The leader collects the name and phone number of the parents.
hikes.additional: For hikes and camps, we also collect:
list: health information relevant for planning and execution
hikes.examples: Examples: allergies, medication, sleep difficulties, fears, diagnoses, or anything else leaders need to know to support the child.
hikes.deletion: The information is stored responsibly during the activity and deleted immediately afterwards.

other.title: Other
other.cookies: The HSS website may use cookies to analyze visitor behavior.
